title: repo2ree behaviour journal record
description: One line of a behaviour journal. Generated from assurance/spec/vocabulary by `python -m repo2ree_assurance_checker generate-schema`; do not edit. Sequence, epochs, and the header are checked per journal by `python -m repo2ree_assurance_checker validate-journal`.

undeclared.description: A subject the vocabulary does not declare: the owner's own, never judged.

Attempt.description: One command execution inside an REE, from its pending record to its published capture. Evidence: git.

AuthorApiAction.description: One thing an author asked of an REE, from the request to the answer they were given. Evidence: journal.

Execution.description: One executor process a workbench started for a command, from its start to its end, across workbench restarts. Evidence: journal.

Receipt.description: One step's receipt, and whether it still speaks for the REE as it now stands. Evidence: git.

Ree.description: The author REE's committed state: authored while draft, frozen once sealed. Evidence: git.

WorkbenchSession.description: One workbench's connection serving one store, from its hello to the end of its socket. Evidence: journal.

cancel_run.description: One request to stop the executor of a started command, and the single outcome the sender observed.

follow_run.description: One watch over a started command, until it ends or the session it was sent on does.

start_run.description: One typed command sent to a workbench to start, and the single answer the sender observed.
